properties.name: extra_benefits_by_rank
properties.source_quote: An additional benefit is gained if the character held rank O4, and two for rank O5. A character with rank O6 gains three extra benefits.
properties.unmodelled: Only the rank half of this sentence is in the graph. The base count - one benefit per term served in which benefits were not lost - is a rate over a filtered count, which needs arithmetic and a count the rule language does not yet have, so the procedure still does it.
